node.label: nephropathic cystinosis
node.definition: An autosomal recessive condition caused by mutation(s) in the CTNS gene, encoding cystinosin. It is a sub-type of cystinosis, in which accumulation of cystine in the kidney results in renal dysfunction.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
